scope: Static first-party source audit of Wake at the recorded commit: T1 close reading plus bounded reads for the FTS5/LIKE, discovery/scan/watch/freshness, MCP/CLI and cleanup questions; no build/test/install/network/git-write execution.
t1_scope_rule: T1 core six files (scanner, adapters/mod, adapters/codex, models, mcp/tools, cli) must be personally read end-to-end; db.rs is partial with grep-localized bounded reads recorded as ranges; claude.rs and opencode.rs are budget-conditional (claude.rs read in full, opencode.rs partial). line_count_method: UTF-8 splitlines; 1-based inclusive read ranges; final newline does not create an extra logical source line.
read_method: PowerShell line-numbered Get-Content segments (<=150 lines per call); truncated chunks were recovered by re-reading the gap.
codegraph_note: Wake has no .codegraph index; all receipts come from line-numbered PowerShell reads.
